title: Exercise credential cleanup and survivor isolation during account deletion
classification: Confirmed acceptance coverage gap; existing CASCADE foreign keys should remove the departing account's credentials, but the populated deletion fixture did not verify them or survivor isolation.

change.fixture: The PostgreSQL account-deletion fixture now creates an active persistent login session, API token, and encrypted linked-store account for both the departing member and the surviving admin.
change.expectation: Deletion removes the departing member, their login session, token, and linked-store credential; the survivor's active session, token, and linked-store account remain present.

verification.result: passed: 6 tests on Python 3.14.10 and PostgreSQL 17.6
verification.schema: Fresh uniquely named PostgreSQL test database upgraded from the repository Alembic baseline through d6e7f8a9b0c1.
verification.cleanup: The disposable database was dropped after the passing run.

limits: This verifies current ORM and migration schema behavior, not an operator's deployed schema.
The broader P2-09 populated-relation tabletop and P2-10 injected failures at every transaction stage remain open.
